title: QMA has perfect completeness
summary: We prove $\mathsf{QMA} = \mathsf{QMA_1}$, i.e., every quantum Merlin-Arthur proof system can be made perfectly complete. Our construction uses only Hadamard, Toffoli, and $X$ gates, yielding a universal gate set for $\mathsf{QMA_1}$. As a consequence, quantum $3$-SAT is $\mathsf{QMA}$-complete. The construction relativizes to classical oracles, so known classical-oracle separations of $\mathsf{QMA}$ from $\mathsf{QCMA}$ extend to $\mathsf{QMA_1}$.
